# When supported practice becomes a shift

The mentor covered lunch and the newcomer was suddenly alone. Calling the session supported practice did not keep the support in the room. We need an explicit handover, not a reassuring title. [[Volunteer handbook]] should say who is responsible during breaks. A person must be able to pause ticket sales without being made to feel they failed the exercise.
